name: Lens & Cataract
description: A 15-episode series on the crystalline lens — cataract types, pre-operative assessment, IOL selection, and the post-operative care that optometrists provide.

episodes.title: Crystalline Lens Anatomy and the Mechanism of Cataract Formation
episodes.description: The lens anatomy (capsule, epithelium, cortex, nucleus), the optical function, and the biochemical mechanisms (oxidation, glycation) of cataract.

episodes.title: Cortical Cataracts: The Spokes, the Wedges, and the Glare Symptom
episodes.description: The cortical cataract slit lamp appearance, the glare and monocular diplopia symptoms, and the LOCS III grading.

episodes.title: Nuclear Sclerosis: The Brown Lens, the Myopic Shift, and the "Second Sight"
episodes.description: The nuclear cataract colour grading, the index myopia and the "second sight of the aged", and the IOL calculation challenge.

episodes.title: Posterior Subcapsular Cataracts: The Younger Patient and the Steroid Cause
episodes.description: The PSC location and the disproportionate glare and near vision impact, the steroid and diabetes causes, and the earlier surgery indication.

episodes.title: Congenital and Juvenile Cataracts: The Deprivation Amblyopia Risk
episodes.description: The congenital cataract types (nuclear, lamellar, posterior polar), the deprivation amblyopia urgency, and the genetic and metabolic workup.

episodes.title: Traumatic Cataracts: The Rosette, the Phacodonesis, and the Zonular Assessment
episodes.description: The traumatic rosette cataract, the zonular dialysis assessment, and the surgical complexity and the IOL fixation challenge.

episodes.title: Pre-Operative Cataract Assessment: The Vision, the Glare, and the Patient Goal
episodes.description: The pre-op acuity and contrast and glare testing, the patient lifestyle and visual goal, and the IOL candidacy and the ocular surface optimisation.

episodes.title: Biometry and IOL Calculations: The Axial Length, the Keratometry, and the Formulas
episodes.description: The IOLMaster and Lenstar biometry, the axial length and keratometry, the Barrett and Hill-RBF and the post-refractive challenge.

episodes.title: Premium IOL Selection: Multifocal, EDOF, and Toric — The Patient Match
episodes.description: The patient personality and lifestyle assessment, the IOL selection (multifocal, EDOF, toric), and the dysphotopsia and contrast counselling.

episodes.title: Toric IOL Alignment: The Axis Marking, the Post-Op Rotation, and the IOL Exchange
episodes.description: The pre-op axis marking at the slit lamp, the post-op rotation assessment, and the threshold for IOL repositioning.

episodes.title: Post-Cataract Visual Recovery: The 1-Day, 1-Week, and 1-Month Milestones
episodes.description: The expected visual recovery timeline, the post-op medication taper, and the optometric co-management schedule.

episodes.title: Posterior Capsule Opacification: The YAG Laser Indication and Timing
episodes.description: The PCO presentation, the visual impact, the YAG capsulotomy timing (after refractive stability), and the RD and IOP risks.

episodes.title: Cystoid Macular Edema After Cataract Surgery: The Irvine-Gass Syndrome
episodes.description: The post-cataract CME (Irvine-Gass), the OCT confirmation, the topical NSAID and steroid treatment, and the chronic case management.

episodes.title: Endophthalmitis Prophylaxis: The Antibiotic Choice and the Post-Op Red Eye Triage
episodes.description: The pre- and intra- and post-operative antibiotic protocols, the post-op red eye triage, and the urgent endophthalmitis referral.

episodes.title: When to Refer for Cataract Surgery: The Functional Impairment Standard
episodes.description: The cataract surgery indication (functional impairment, not acuity alone), the shared decision-making, and the timing and the second-eye surgery.
